headline: Binance Intake Falls To 69.5 Million Dollars From 116.2 Million As Bybit Takes In 96.6 Million
narrative: The 24-hour intake of dollars held on Binance, excluding the venue's own token, fell to 69.5 million dollars from 116.2 million dollars, which means fewer dollars arrived on the largest venue where holders can sell. Bybit took in 96.6 million dollars over the same window, which means dollars arrived on that venue where holders can sell, while Bitstamp sent out 81.2 million dollars, compared with 64.0 million dollars on the prior print. Across trading venues, the same measure was a 125.8 million dollar net outflow, 0.0461 percent of custodied value, compared with a 123.0 million dollar outflow and 0.0452 percent on the prior print, which means dollars are still leaving venues overall while the Binance intake shrank.
author: jordan
